title: Gary McKinnon's hack and the tic tac image
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Gary McKinnon's hack and the tic tac image, about 2001 at NASA mission control, Houston, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
he queried the Johnson Space Center
because there were um there was a a UFO
whistleblower named Donna Hair
And McKinnon hacks in and he starts to see a a UFO pop up and populate on his screen. It's a tic-tac UFO and it's orbiting Earth
tellings.difference: Dates it 2002-2003, says the tic-tac was orbiting Earth, and adds Steven Greer and the Disclosure Project book.
tellings.link_reason: Gary McKinnon hacking US networks and seeing a tic-tac UFO image is the same hack-and-image story.

as_told.title: Gary McKinnon hacks US networks and sees a tic-tac UFO
as_told.place_text: UK / US military and NASA networks

tellings.quote: And McKinnon then sees a UFO pop up on his screen. He sees a tic-tac UFO that seems to be orbiting Earth pop up on his screen.
tellings.difference: Describes the tic-tac as seeming to orbit Earth and places it in Building 8, 2001-2002.
tellings.link_reason: Same story of Gary McKinnon's hack of the Johnson Space Center systems and the tic-tac image appearing on his screen.

as_told.title: Gary McKinnon sees tic-tac UFO in NASA system
as_told.place_text: NASA Johnson Space Center Building 8, Houston

tellings.quote: then suddenly there's a big straight kind of silvery line and then it's coming down. Then that's I guess what they now call a tic tac but what we used to call cigar- shaped
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by McKinnon, who describes a silvery cigar-shaped line coming down rather than an object orbiting Earth.
tellings.link_reason: McKinnon seeing a cigar or Tic Tac shaped craft in a Johnson Space Center Building 8 image, linked to Donna Hare. This is the same as the story of his hack and the tic tac image.

as_told.title: McKinnon views a cigar-shaped craft in NASA Building 8 image
as_told.place_text: Building 8, Johnson Space Center (accessed remotely from London)

tellings.quote: you're saying you saw a tic tac, you know, in deep space but above Earth
tellings.difference: Dates it c. 2001-2002 and describes it as being in deep space above Earth. Jesse Michels puts it to McKinnon directly in the interview.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of McKinnon seeing a tic-tac UFO orbiting Earth in NASA imagery during his hack, around 2001.

as_told.title: Tic Tac object in space seen in hacked files

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how a British computer hacker named Gary McKinnon, around 2001 or 2002, broke into computers at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston after hearing a former NASA worker, Donna Hare, claim UFOs were being hidden. Michels says McKinnon saw an image pop up on his screen of a white oval craft shaped like a Tic Tac mint that seemed to be orbiting Earth, which would mean NASA holds evidence of unknown craft in space.
